name: ui-prototype-migration
description: Migrate an existing, already-designed HTML/CSS UI prototype into a component-based frontend (Vue 3 first) while preserving its exact rendered output and behavior — not a UI design generator. Co-locate scoped component CSS, carry design tokens and inline styles verbatim, and verify parity per view/theme/viewport via Playwright computed-style + pixel diff and axe-core accessibility. Includes /migrate-prototype and /verify-parity commands.
